summary.text: Ralph Hise is a Republican member of the North Carolina State Senate who has represented District 47 since January 2011 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ralph Hise earned a bachelor's degree in statistics from Appalachian State University in 2000 and a master's degree in higher education administration from North Carolina State University in 2003, according to Ballotpedia.
His professional experience includes serving on the faculty of Mayland Community College in Spruce Pine, North Carolina.
Hise assumed office in the State Senate on January 1, 2011.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments as Finance, Health Care, Pensions and Retirement and Aging, and Rules and Operations of the Senate.
